architecture.pattern: read-only analysis orchestrator behind the declarative tool registry
architecture.isolation_boundaries: No wallet access, calldata generation, signing, flash-loan selection, relay dispatch, or broadcast.
execution_flow: Fetch the current Morpho position and supplied candidate market summaries.
Evaluate LTV, health, maturity, carry, and capacity evidence.
Return a provenance-labelled, non-executable research intent.

outputs.current_position: base-unit strings, LTV bps, health factor, and provenance
outputs.candidates: liquidity, utilization, capacity status, and deterministic rank

test_criteria: Schema parsing applies the documented risk-policy defaults.
High-risk positions with compatible capacity return RESEARCH_ROLLOVER and a non-executable intent.
Candidate failures remain visible without hiding current-position analysis.
The complete test suite and TypeScript check pass except for documented unrelated baseline failures.
